```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(lingtypology)
library(dplyr)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

## Lingokartor

Ladda data
```{r}
df <- read.csv("./lingosprak.csv") %>%
  filter(Glottokod != "-")
df$lang <- lang.gltc(df$Glottokod)
df$popup <- paste0(df$Tävling, " ", df$År)
```

Skapa karta
```{r}
df_map <- df %>% 
  filter(!is.na(lang)) %>% 
  group_by(lang) %>%
  reframe(popup = paste0("(", Språk, ") <br> ", paste(unique(popup), collapse = ", "))) %>%
  unique()
m <- map.feature(languages = df_map$lang, popup = df_map$popup)
saveWidget(m, "lingosprak.html")
```
